properties.description: One gateway PC fronts the connected manufacturing equipment.
Configure compatible parts independently. Shared gear train and mounting family.

instructions: Check that each selected part is in its marked tray position.
Record damaged or missing parts before submitting the tray for inspection.

completion_instructions: Open the guard only after the equipment is stopped.
Unload the processed gears and pins. Check for damage before passing on the tray.
Record any material loss from the operation.
instructions: Load the five gears, five Pin 1 pieces and one Pin 2 according to the station fixture.
Close the guard after loading. Start equipment only when the fixture is secure and the work area is clear.
Fit {parts.base.name} from bin {parts.base.bin} into the assembly fixture.
Install the five gears and pins in the indicated mounting positions.
Turn the handle slowly. The propeller must rotate freely without rubbing.
Check that the assembled {product.name} contains the selected parts.
Turn the handle and inspect smooth gear movement, secure casing, and propeller clearance.
Photograph the finished assembly so the selected parts and connections are visible.
Confirm that each selected part is present, correct, and undamaged. Check all five gears, five Pin 1 pieces, one Pin 2, casing halves, handle, and propeller.
Confirm correct selected parts, secure pin and gear connections, and intact assembly. Reference photographs show the overall design; the order's independently selected part colours are authoritative.

constraints.name: Selected parts use a compatible mounting family
